question: Has Tokyo condo resale market liquidity fallen
observation: Official REINS Tokyo wards transactions down 26.9 percent and mean sqm transacted price down 4.0 percent
not_established: Same-quality prices or professional seller loss-making exits

question: Is mean price fall solely due to shift from wards to Tama
observation: Two-region composition explains approximately 23.2 percent of observed two-region average sqm price decline
can_support: Tokyo wards mean sqm price fell independently of wards-Tama mix
not_established: Within-ward unit quality mix or repeat-sale price changes

question: Is high end market liquidity weaker
observation: Tokyo 100m-200m monthly conversion 11 to 6 percent and 200m+ 5 to 2 percent
can_support: Price-band conversion weakness within Tokyo resale
not_established: Individual listing markdown or realized sale duration

question: Does operator selling conversion mirror high end weak market
observation: Star Mica 100m+ renovation sales conversion 17 to 9 percent and 42 active listings; below 100m conversion 30 to 27 percent with 442 listings
can_support: An operator itself reports disproportionate high-end slowdown
not_established: Tokyo-based share of 42 listings or time-to-sale or liquidation

question: Does slower conversion imply realized accounting write-downs
observation: Star Mica Q3 cumulative used-condo valuation losses 0.3bn to 0.1bn yen
can_support: Company has not reported large rising resale book write-downs
not_established: No individual sale discounts or losses

question: Has Landnet disclosed margin compression from high price sectional condos
observation: Landnet FY2026 high-priced sectional condo selling prices stalled and gross margin fell
can_support: A specific operator's gross margin was affected by high-end selling price weakness
not_established: Tokyo-only condo operating margin or forced selling

question: Does market sales contraction imply all Tokyo condo resellers sold fewer
observation: Intellex FY2026 Q1 Tokyo23 renovation resale sales 44 to 52 units
can_support: At least one Tokyo23 operator showed growth in completed sales
not_established: Uncontracted inventory and later 2026 October effect

question: Does high procurement capital imply unsold stock
observation: Intellex Tokyo23 purchases 65 to 70 with mean 31 to 55 million yen
can_support: Approximate capital outlay rises sharply as procurement ticket increases
not_established: Same unit gross margin or stock aging

question: Do company-year financials establish 15-operator Tokyo exit congestion
observation: Fifteen groups include nine businesses outside primary Tokyo secondhand condo renovation resale and three conditional firms
can_support: Do not equate companywide real estate inventory with Tokyo resale stock
not_established: Representative Tokyo industry averages or fifteen company generalization

question: Can company-wide profit disprove price-tier slowdown
observation: Star Mica FY2026 Q3 gross profit of vacant renovations 33.7bn yen against 43.5bn full-year revised forecast; OC others already 103 percent of plan
can_support: Weak high-price sales conversion and positive other exit-channel progress can coexist
not_established: 2026 full-year vacant renovation miss or forced-sale loss
